title: SIMV-PC with a high ETS: early-cycled supported breaths and a mandatory clock that stacks
summary: A patient breathing at 24 a minute on SIMV-PC with 14 mandatory breaths a minute and PS 8. The supported breaths cycle off at 60 % of peak flow while the effort continues, so either the patient re-triggers inside the same effort or the mandatory clock delivers a breath on top of it: stacked volumes, a short expiration, a rising baseline.
objectives: Recognize breath stacking from the mandatory clock: two breaths in one effort, the second time-triggered, with a truncated expiration.
Fix it by letting the patient own the rhythm: pressure support (or assist-control) instead of SIMV.

fix.note: PSV with PS 10 and ETS 25 %: one breath per effort, cycled when the effort ends.
